args.body: Take SOFTWARE-AWARD-BRIEF-EXPOSURE. Turn the existing verified brief into a reviewable free exposure experiment rather than generating more inventory. Verify the source interpretation, especially award records with cancelled tender statuses, before public presentation. Existing hosting receipts support trying publication through the host gate; configuration alone does not guarantee success. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance only. Keep the work bounded to preparation and independent review handoff; no deployment this turn, no speculative procurement dates, no outreach, and no changes to the three existing experiments. Unclassified feedback remains unknown.

description: Three official software-award records now support a useful supplier brief, including an explicitly planned competitive EPR procurement with no published date. Prepare a bounded public exposure test from that existing work. Feedback remains uncertain: three unclassified sources establish neither requests nor zero demand. Verified funds and revenue remain zero; payment collection blocks paid acceptance, but does not block this free publication experiment.
